art_direction: 裂开的青铜种荚露出光洁内壁与小种子，铜绿和暖金属色形成反差。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Create an original bronze seed-pod sculpture resting open on one side. Its outer shell has a dark green patina with subtle pits and branching seams; the inner surface is warm, smoother bronze. Place three rounded seed forms within the opening, arranged as one clear cluster. Light the interior gently so the shell frames a warm focal point. Use a deep muted background and a low stone surface. Keep the entire object compact and botanical in spirit, with no gears, fantasy weapons, or decorative inscriptions. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
